fact: The lift consists of a swinging arm, a hand-cranked horizontal spool, several pulleys, and a heavy woven basket supported by spider-silk cord.
source_quote: Zalthir saw that the lift consisted of a swinging arm, a hand-cranked horizontal spool, several pulleys, and a heavy woven basket supported by spider-silk cord.
subject: lift mechanism

fact: Zalthir discovers a mysterious list of people belonging to a nearby settlement while removing rubbish from the lift basket.
source_quote: While removing the rubbish left by passengers, Zalthir discovered a mysterious list of people belonging to a nearby settlement.
subject: Zalthir discovers settlement list

fact: Jimjar proposes wagers on lift usage and is willing to extend credit to prisoners who have no money.
source_quote: Despite having no money in captivity, he was perfectly willing to extend credit, assuring the prisoners, “As long as you're willing to trust me as the bookkeeper, I'm willing to go on credit.”
subject: Jimjar

fact: Jimjar displays an almost freakish ability to remember precisely how much has been wagered, won, and lost.
source_quote: Jimjar displayed an almost freakish ability to remember precisely how much had been wagered, won, and lost.
subject: Jimjar

fact: Eldeth periodically accepts Jimjar's bets.
source_quote: Eldeth periodically accepted his bets
subject: Eldeth

fact: The spider-silk cord supporting the lift basket is extremely hard to cut with a blade.
source_quote: The spider-silk cord was extremely hard to cut
subject: spider-silk cord

fact: The spider-silk cord is vulnerable to fire, as Zalthir's fire breath burns the webbing.
source_quote: the webbing burned, and the rope would give way to flame much more readily than to a blade
subject: spider-silk cord

fact: The hand-cranked zurkhwood winch of the lift cannot be broken without tools.
source_quote: the hand-cranked zurkhwood winch could not be broken without tools
subject: hand-cranked zurkhwood winch

fact: Daz suggests freezing part of the lift mechanism with Shape Water using frozen spit to jam it.
source_quote: Daz suggested freezing part of the mechanism with Shape Water, using something as simple as frozen spit to damage or jam it.
subject: Daz suggests freezing mechanism

fact: Zalthir realizes his fire breath can damage the wooden mechanism and the extensive webs surrounding the outpost.
source_quote: The same fire could potentially damage the wooden mechanism and the extensive webs surrounding the outpost.
subject: Zalthir

fact: The lift appears to be the only visible safe way to descend from the barracks level.
source_quote: It appeared to be the only visible way to descend safely from the barracks level without cutting a rope or risking the tremendous drop.
subject: barracks level

fact: Two quaggoths supervise the lift.
source_quote: Two quaggoths supervise the lift.
subject: quaggoths

fact: The quaggoths force Zalthir to clean the basket and amuse themselves by dropping it a short distance before hauling it back up.
source_quote: They force Zalthir to clean the basket and amuse themselves by dropping it a short distance before hauling it back up.
subject: quaggoths harass Zalthir

fact: Zalthir is assigned to work at the lift.
source_quote: with Zalthir assigned to the lift
subject: Zalthir assigned to lift

fact: Gyrgum is sent to the food preparation area.
source_quote: Gyrgum sent to the food preparation area
subject: Gyrgum assigned to kitchen

fact: Someone presses Jimjar on who the word "we" includes when he bets on the group escaping alive.
source_quote: someone presses Jimjar on who that “we” includes: all of them, or just “you and me”?
subject: Jimjar asked about 'we'

fact: Eldeth finds a comb which is potentially valuable in the filthy conditions of the slave pen.
source_quote: Eldeth finds a comb, potentially valuable in the filthy conditions of the slave pen.
subject: comb

fact: The drow dining hall contains four circular zurkhwood tables, each surrounded by five chairs.
source_quote: The drow dining hall contains four circular zurkhwood tables, each surrounded by five chairs.
subject: drow dining hall

fact: The dining hall stores include fresh and dried fungi, dried fruit, cheese, preserved meat, and jars of spices.
source_quote: Its stores include fresh and dried fungi, dried fruit, cheese, preserved meat, and jars of spices.
subject: dining hall stores

fact: A heavy iron brazier in the dining hall supplies cooking heat and dim light.
source_quote: A heavy iron brazier supplies cooking heat and dim light
subject: heavy iron brazier

fact: Four drow are eating and entertaining themselves with dice or cards when Gyrgum arrives.
source_quote: Four drow are eating and entertaining themselves with dice or cards when Gyrgum arrives.
subject: drow eating

fact: Topsy and Turvy immediately begin looking for an opportunity to steal food.
source_quote: Topsy and Turvy immediately begin looking for an opportunity to steal food.
subject: twins seek food

fact: Gyrgum attempts to talk to the drow but cannot understand their Undercommon.
source_quote: Gyrgum attempts to talk to the drow but cannot understand their Undercommon.
subject: Gyrgum cannot understand drow

fact: Shuushar announces he will omit colorful adjectives for the sake of his spiritual and mental balance, then enumerates the insults anyway.
source_quote: Shuushar announces that he will omit many of the “colorful adjectives” for the sake of his own spiritual and mental balance—then enumerates the insults anyway.
subject: Shuushar

fact: The drow question Gyrgum's ancestry and viability, and suggest he make them a meal instead of talking.
source_quote: Shuushar explains that the drow question Gyrgum's ancestry, viability, and species, and suggest that, instead of talking to them, he make them a tasty meal.
subject: drow insult Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum uses performance to prepare a meal, impressing the drow who offer rare praise.
source_quote: Gyrgum uses performance to manipulate, combine, and dramatically sizzle the ingredients. The meal's presentation and preparation impress the drow, who offer rare praise.
subject: Gyrgum impresses drow

fact: Gyrgum notices accessible knives in the kitchen and realizes only slaves cook, meaning theft might go unnoticed.
source_quote: Looking around the kitchen, Gyrgum notices accessible knives and realizes that only slaves perform the cooking, meaning a discreet theft might go unnoticed.
subject: Gyrgum spots knives

fact: Topsy advises stealing carefully and quietly, pointedly looking at Gyrgum's massive body.
source_quote: Topsy advises that stealing should be done “carefully, quietly, and not make a big production of it,” pointedly looking at Gyrgum's massive body.
subject: Topsy

fact: Gyrgum's conspicuous attempt to distract the drow results in a guard catching him holding the knife up.
source_quote: but his attempt is so conspicuous that a drow catches him holding the knife up.
subject: Gyrgum caught with knife

fact: Gyrgum tells the guard he is going to sharpen the knife, and his performance persuades the drow not to punish him.
source_quote: Challenged by the guard, Gyrgum says, “I'm going to sharpen this knife.” His performance and the goodwill from his meal persuade the drow not to punish him.
subject: Gyrgum excuses theft

fact: The drow warn Gyrgum that another attempt could cost him various body parts.
source_quote: The drow nevertheless warn that another attempt could cost Gyrgum “various body parts.”
subject: drow warn Gyrgum

fact: On the following day, Gyrgum asks Topsy and Turvy to steal the knives due to increased drow supervision.
source_quote: On the following day, six or seven drow are present and paying close attention to Gyrgum's celebrated cooking. Rather than risk another personal attempt, he asks Topsy and Turvy to steal the knives.
subject: Gyrgum asks twins to steal

fact: Topsy and Turvy successfully bring two knives back to the prisoners.
source_quote: The twins successfully bring two knives back to the prisoners.
subject: twins steal knives

fact: The stolen knives are treated as ordinary daggers and sharpened by Gyrgum.
source_quote: The group treats them as ordinary daggers, and Gyrgum sharpens them.
subject: stolen knives
